author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: These parsers read Splashtop Enterprise SIEM Logging team history and session log records in Elastic Common Schema. A push mode app sends them straight to HTTP Ingest. Failed logins go to Auth and every other team history and session log record goes to CloudAudit.
notes:
Setup:
- SIEM Logging is a Splashtop Enterprise feature.
- Under Management > SIEM Logging, create a push mode app with Integration Others, the Sophos NG-SIEM HTTP Ingest URL, the integration key as the Authentication Token, and Log format Elastic Common Schema.
- Splashtop doesn't document the header it puts the token in; HTTP Ingest needs Authorization: Bearer, so if records don't arrive, put a small relay in front that adds that header.

Field mapping:
- Failed logins (team history kinds 159, 315, 316 and 375, from Splashtop's Open API guide) go to Auth; every other team history and session log record goes to CloudAudit.

Made up in the samples:
- Splashtop publishes one ECS sample, a team history record: the session and login records in samples.log follow its layout, but their event action, code and category values are made up.

Testing:
- Each child, combined with the parent into one parser, passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13 (51 of 51 fields matched the emulator), and the parent's confirm string picked the same lines there.
- On 2026-10-14 each child also passed Run Test in a lab tenant as a separate parser under its parent.
- No built-in parser claimed these lines in 5 Run Tests.

Known gaps:
- Business Access and Remote Support have no SIEM export.
